input: Build a fire pit in the backyard this fall

gold.taskTitle: Build a Backyard Fire Pit This Fall
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to build a fire pit in their backyard during the fall season.

questions.title: What type of fire pit do you want to build?
questions.description: In-ground, above-ground, stone ring, brick, metal insert, prefab kit, etc.

questions.title: What is your target completion month this fall?
questions.description: September, October, or November — or a specific date or deadline.

questions.title: What is your budget for this project?
questions.description: A rough dollar range covering materials, tools, and any hired labor.

questions.title: Will you build it yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Whether this is a DIY project, fully contracted out, or a mix of both.

questions.title: What size fire pit are you planning for?
questions.description: Approximate diameter or seating capacity the user has in mind.

questions.title: Are there local permits or HOA rules to consider?
questions.description: Whether the user knows of any municipal codes, fire ordinances, or HOA restrictions in their area.

questions.title: What material do you want the fire pit built from?
questions.description: Stone, brick, concrete block, steel, pavers, or a prefabricated unit.
